hooks.command: sh -c 'SECRET="${BERNSTEIN_HOOK_SECRET:-$BERNSTEIN_AUTH_TOKEN}"; BODY=$(cat); SIG=$(printf "%s" "$BODY" | openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac "$SECRET" -hex | awk "{print \$2}"); curl -sS -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Bernstein-Hook-Signature-256: sha256=$SIG" -d "$BODY" http://127.0.0.1:8052/hooks/backend-a72f7c00'
